messages:
jamal-recruiter: Heads up — several panel interviews today where interviewers say they didn’t get the scorecard link in their calendar invite. Candidates still have feedback pending.

sarah-peopleops: Which panel(s)? can you paste one example?

jamal-recruiter: 2:30 PM SRE interview for candidate C-1245. Calendar invite has description "Interview with Redwood" but no scorecard link. Attendees show product+eng+infra.

maria-hiringops: I just pulled the ATS audit and I see the scorecard created, but the calendar sync webhook returned 202 then later a 409 for the same invite id.

ats-bot: ats-bot: webhook delivery failed for delivery_id=ddb3f1: 409 Conflict - mapping_exists

kevin-intops: Possible race between scorecard provisioning and calendar invite enrichment. We recently flipped the new "enrich-on-create" flag in staging -> prod last night.

tom-eng-mgr: Can we hotfix to include the scorecard URL in a follow-up invite/patch so interviewers get it before the session?

kevin-intops: Quick mitigation: I'll add a fallback that appends the scorecard link to the invite body if enrichment hasn't completed within 30s. Deploying now to the pipeline.

jamal-recruiter: Appreciate it. Can we also surface a clear signal in the ATS UI for "scorecard not attached to invite" so I can chase proactively?

sarah-peopleops: Yes — long-term we need a dashboard and queued reminders for interviewers missing scorecards. For now, can recruiting ops send a manual reminder when patch is applied?

kevin-intops: Patch rolled to prod, logs show retry succeeded and invites updated for the 2 affected candidates. Example payload we retried:

```
POST /calendar/patch
{
  "invite_id": "invite-9a7",
  "fields": {
    "body": "Interview prep: scorecard -> https://ats.redwood/example/C-1245"
  }
}
```

maria-hiringops: Confirmed — calendar shows updated body with link. I messaged the interviewers.

jamal-recruiter: Thanks team. One follow-up: a couple of interviewers reported they completed interview training last week but their "trained" badge didn't show on the panel roster. Could this be related?

kevin-intops: Might be; training completion is a separate webhook that writes to user metadata. If those writes overlapped with recruiter updates we could have a stale cache read. I'll trace the event stream.

sarah-peopleops: If there's a cache TTL issue, we should make the roster read strongly consistent for training flags. Prioritizing in OKR for next sprint. Meanwhile, maria — can recruiting manually verify training badges for tomorrow's panels?

maria-hiringops: On it. I'll run a quick audit for this week and put a checklist in the interview ops playbook.

tom-eng-mgr: Thanks. Also please add brief note to oncall runbook so on-call knows to check webhook 409s for calendar enrichment.

jamal-recruiter: All good from my side — will update candidates and interviewers. :thumbsup:

ats-bot: ats-bot: ingest-event: calendar_patch_succeeded for invite-9a7 at 1836543248

kevin-intops: I'll follow up with a short postmortem and a sticky in the people-ops channel summarizing actions.

sarah-peopleops: Perfect — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround! :clap:
